snippet.title: Rift of the NecroDancer & Celeste Music Pack | Nintendo Switch Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Rift of the NecroDancer is a rhythm game where the music fights back. Now available Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/en-ca/store/products/rift-of-the-necrodancer-switch/

And that’s not all! Keep the musical combat flowing with the paid DLC, Celeste Music Pack, strawberry jam-packed with four iconic tracks from the award-winning Lena Raine, and a FREE dannyBstyle remix of Resurrections for all.

Brace Yourself Games: https://www.braceyourselfgames.com
